rungs.fact-null-momenta-invite-one-rung:
"""rungs.fact-null-momenta-invite-one-rung: exact checks.

Null momenta p = e0 + n (n a rational unit spatial vector) in R^(1,3) subset Cl(1,3) (e0^2 = +1).
(1) No equivariant element-level inverse. For two null momenta, and in Cl(1,3) itself, in its one-vector
    extensions Cl(1,4), Cl(2,3) and in the rung Cl(2,4): the null rotations R_w = 1 + p w/2 (w spacelike,
    w . p = 0; two such w) are rotors fixing p, and the linear system
        p s p = p,  R_w s R_w~ = s  (both w)
    for an unknown element s of the whole algebra has no solution (exact rank test: the augmented rank
    exceeds the coefficient rank), while p s p = p alone is solvable. So no pseudo-inverse of p is fixed by
    the stabiliser of p in Spin^0(1,3), in any of these algebras: p stays a zero divisor (p^2 = 0 there).
(2) One rung for all momenta. In Cl(2,4) (e+ at index 4 square +1, e- at 5 square -1, n0 = (e- - e+)/2,
    ninf = e- + e+) the lifts X(x) = n0 + x + Q(x) ninf/2 of six null momenta are all null; the lift of 0
    and the lifts of the first k momenta span min(k + 1, 5) dimensions (null lifts lie in span{n0, e0..e3}),
    so the six null lifts plus the lift of 0 span 5, and with one non-null point (which uses ninf) all 6:
    every momentum lifts into the same R^(2,4), which does not grow with n. Its adjoined plane has Gram
    signature (1,1). Minimality and uniqueness of the rung are imported, not tested.
(3) The transported reciprocal iota(a n0 + x + b ninf) = 2b n0 + x + (a/2) ninf preserves the quadric, is an
    involution, and sends every X(p^i) to p^i + ninf/2 (n0-coefficient 0: an ideal point), all six at once;
    on a non-null x it returns X(x/Q(x)) up to the scale Q(x).
"""
from fractions import Fraction as F

import GA
from tp_premise import premise

S13 = GA.sig(1, 3)
MOMENTA = [(1, F(3, 5), F(4, 5), 0), (1, 0, 0, 1), (1, F(5, 13), 0, F(12, 13)),
           (1, F(-2, 3), F(1, 3), F(2, 3)), (1, 0, F(-1), 0), (1, F(2, 7), F(3, 7), F(-6, 7))]


def v(c):
    return {(i,): F(x) for i, x in enumerate(c) if x != 0}


def perp_spacelike(c):
    """Two independent spatial vectors orthogonal to n (cross products of n with basis vectors): spacelike and
    orthogonal to p = e0 + n."""
    n = c[1:]
    basis = [(1, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0), (0, 0, 1)]
    ws = []
    for b in basis:
        cr = (n[1] * b[2] - n[2] * b[1], n[2] * b[0] - n[0] * b[2], n[0] * b[1] - n[1] * b[0])
        if any(x != 0 for x in cr) and len(ws) < 2:
            if not ws or GA.rank_of_vectors([list(ws[0]), list(cr)]) == 2:
                ws.append(cr)
    return [(0,) + w for w in ws]


def lin_system(S, nvars, p, Rs):
    blades = GA.all_blades(nvars)
    idx = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(blades)}
    N = len(blades)
    rows, rhs = [], []
    # p s p = p
    cols = [GA.mul(GA.mul(p, {b: F(1)}, S), p, S) for b in blades]
    for t in blades:
        rows.append([cols[j].get(t, F(0)) for j in range(N)])
        rhs.append(p.get(t, F(0)))
    base_rows = (rows[:], rhs[:])
    for (R, Rt) in Rs:
        cols = [GA.sub(GA.mul(GA.mul(R, {b: F(1)}, S), Rt, S), {b: F(1)}) for b in blades]
        for t in blades:
            rows.append([cols[j].get(t, F(0)) for j in range(N)])
            rhs.append(F(0))
    return base_rows, (rows, rhs), idx


def solvable(rows, rhs):
    aug = [r + [c] for r, c in zip(rows, rhs)]
    return GA.rank_of_vectors(aug) == GA.rank_of_vectors(rows)


def check_no_equivariant_pseudo_inverse_in_any_extension():
    premise("rungs.imported-totality-minimality-completion")
    ok = True
    for S in [S13, S13 + (-1,), S13 + (1,), S13 + (1, -1)]:      # Cl(1,3), Cl(1,4), Cl(2,3), Cl(2,4)
        n = len(S)
        for c in MOMENTA[:2]:
            p = v(c)
            ok = ok and GA.is_zero(GA.mul(p, p, S))
            Rs = []
            for w in perp_spacelike(c):
                wv = v(w)
                ok = ok and GA.dot(wv, p, S) == 0 and GA.mul(wv, wv, S)[()] < 0
                R = GA.add(GA.sc(1), GA.scal(F(1, 2), GA.mul(p, wv, S)))
                Rt = GA.reverse(R)
                ok = ok and GA.eq(GA.mul(R, Rt, S), GA.sc(1))
                ok = ok and GA.eq(GA.mul(GA.mul(R, p, S), Rt, S), p)
                ok = ok and not GA.eq(R, GA.sc(1))
                Rs.append((R, Rt))
            ok = ok and len(Rs) == 2
            base, full, _ = lin_system(S, n, p, Rs)
            ok = ok and solvable(*base) and not solvable(*full)
    _tp_rv = (ok); assert _tp_rv is not False, "check_no_equivariant_pseudo_inverse_in_any_extension"; return _tp_rv


S24 = (1, -1, -1, -1, 1, -1)
EP, EM = GA.gen(4), GA.gen(5)
N0 = GA.scal(F(1, 2), GA.sub(EM, EP))
NINF = GA.add(EM, EP)
# Non-null sample points for iota(X(x)) = Q(x) X(x/Q(x)).
NON_NULL_POINTS = [(2, 1, 0, 0), (1, 2, F(1, 3), 0), (F(1, 2), 0, 0, 3)]


def lift(c):
    x = v(c)
    Q = GA.mul(x, x, S13).get((), F(0))
    return GA.add(N0, x, GA.scal(Q / 2, NINF))


def iota(X):
    # X = a n0 + x + b ninf with n0 = (e- - e+)/2, ninf = e- + e+: e+ coeff = -a/2 + b, e- coeff = a/2 + b
    cp, cm = X.get((4,), F(0)), X.get((5,), F(0))
    a = cm - cp
    b = (cp + cm) / 2
    x = {k: c for k, c in X.items() if k not in ((4,), (5,))}
    return GA.add(GA.scal(2 * b, N0), x, GA.scal(a / 2, NINF))


def check_one_rung_for_all_momenta():
    premise("rungs.imported-totality-minimality-completion")
    ok = GA.congruence_signature([[S24[4], 0], [0, S24[5]]]) == (1, 1, 0)
    ok = ok and GA.is_zero(GA.mul(N0, N0, S24)) and GA.is_zero(GA.mul(NINF, NINF, S24))
    ok = ok and GA.dot(N0, NINF, S24) == -1
    blades = [(i,) for i in range(6)]
    lifts = [lift((0, 0, 0, 0))]
    for k, c in enumerate(MOMENTA):
        X = lift(c)
        ok = ok and GA.is_zero(GA.mul(X, X, S24))
        lifts.append(X)
        rk = GA.rank_of_vectors([[L.get(b, F(0)) for b in blades] for L in lifts])
        ok = ok and rk == min(k + 2, 5)
    lifts.append(lift((0, 1, 0, 0)))                       # one non-null point uses the ninf direction
    ok = ok and GA.rank_of_vectors([[L.get(b, F(0)) for b in blades] for L in lifts]) == 6
    _tp_rv = (ok); assert _tp_rv is not False, "check_one_rung_for_all_momenta"; return _tp_rv


def check_reciprocal_total_on_quadric():
    premise("rungs.imported-totality-minimality-completion")
    ok = True
    for c in MOMENTA:
        X = lift(c)
        Y = iota(X)
        ok = ok and GA.eq(Y, GA.add(v(c), GA.scal(F(1, 2), NINF)))
        ok = ok and GA.is_zero(GA.mul(Y, Y, S24)) and GA.eq(iota(Y), X)
        # ideal point: n0-coefficient 0, read as Y . ninf = 0 (n0 . ninf = -1, x . ninf = ninf . ninf = 0)
        ok = ok and GA.mul(Y, NINF, S24).get((), F(0)) == 0
    qs = []
    for c in NON_NULL_POINTS:
        x = v(c)
        Q = GA.mul(x, x, S13)[()]
        qs.append(Q)
        Y = iota(lift(c))
        ok = ok and GA.eq(Y, GA.scal(Q, lift(tuple(F(t) / Q for t in c))))
        ok = ok and GA.is_zero(GA.mul(Y, Y, S24)) and GA.eq(iota(Y), lift(c))
    # by hand: Q = 4 - 1 = 3, 1 - 4 - 1/9 = -28/9, 1/4 - 9 = -35/4 (the points are non-null)
    ok = ok and qs == [3, F(-28, 9), F(-35, 4)]
    _tp_rv = (ok); assert _tp_rv is not False, "check_reciprocal_total_on_quadric"; return _tp_rv
rungs.imported-fock-representation-bogol:
"""rungs.imported-fock-representation-bogoliubov-group: exact checks of the finite core.

This Fact restates an imported literature fact (its two uses are the T12 Fact and the external
literature entity); the check verifies the content directly and relies on neither, so it makes no
premise() call. The infinite-dimensional and topological parts (compactness of O(2n), the covering
Pin -> O) are not checked; the finite core is, for n = 1, 2, 3 modes.

Fock space Lambda(C^n) has basis |S> (S a subset of the modes), a_i the Jordan-Wigner annihilators,
matrices over the Gaussian rationals (GA.QI). Majorana generators g_{2i} = a_i + a_i^dag and
g_{2i+1} = i (a_i^dag - a_i).
(1) Spinor module: the CAR hold; the 2n Majorana generators satisfy g_j g_k + g_k g_j = 2 delta_jk
(the complex Clifford algebra on 2n generators); their 4^n ordered monomials have rank 4^n, so they
span all of End(C^(2^n)) and the module is irreducible; the vacuum is the unique state killed by
every a_i; the grades have dimensions C(n, k).
(2) Chirality: Gamma = prod (1 - 2 a_i^dag a_i) is diagonal with entry (-1)^|S|, squares to 1,
anticommutes with every g_j, and equals c g_0 g_1 ... g_{2n-1} with c = (-i)^n (the chirality element; g_{2i} g_{2i+1} = i (1 - 2 a_i^dag a_i)).
(3) Bogoliubov group: for rational orthogonal R in O(2n) (Cayley transforms of antisymmetric
matrices, and a reflection), g'_j = sum_k R_jk g_k satisfy the Clifford relations, while a
non-orthogonal R breaks them. Pin implements O: for a unit vector u, x -> -g_u x g_u^-1 sends
g_j to the reflection of g_j in u; a product of two such (Spin) implements the rotation
refl_u refl_w; the reflection is odd and reverses Gamma, the rotation even and keeps it.
(4) The number-preserving part: for g in U(n) with Gaussian-rational entries (n = 2, 3), the
operator Lambda(g), defined by Lambda(g)|S> = (g a^dag_{s1}) ... (g a^dag_{sk}) |0>, is unitary,
commutes with the number operator, satisfies Lambda(g) a_i^dag = (sum_j g_ji a_j^dag) Lambda(g),
multiplies the top state by det g; the induced real 2n x 2n matrix on the Majorana generators is
orthogonal and commutes with the complex structure.
"""
from fractions import Fraction as F
from itertools import combinations

import GA
import fock
from GA import QI

ZERO, ONE, I = QI(0), QI(1), QI(0, 1)
G2 = [[QI(F(3, 5)), QI(0, F(4, 5))], [QI(0, F(4, 5)), QI(F(3, 5))]]
R3A = [[QI(F(3, 5)), QI(F(-4, 5)), ZERO], [QI(F(4, 5)), QI(F(3, 5)), ZERO], [ZERO, ZERO, ONE]]
P3 = [[QI(F(3, 5), F(4, 5)), ZERO, ZERO], [ZERO, QI(F(5, 13), F(-12, 13)), QI(0)], [ZERO, ZERO, ONE]]
B3 = [[ONE, ZERO, ZERO], [ZERO, QI(F(8, 17)), QI(0, F(15, 17))], [ZERO, QI(0, F(15, 17)), QI(F(8, 17))]]
ANTISYM = ([[0, 1, -2, 0], [-1, 0, 3, 1], [2, -3, 0, -1], [0, -1, 1, 0]],
           [[0, F(1, 2), 0, 2], [F(-1, 2), 0, 1, 0], [0, -1, 0, 3], [-2, 0, -3, 0]])
UNIT_U = (F(3, 5), F(4, 5), F(0), F(0))
UNIT_W = (F(0), F(5, 13), F(0), F(12, 13))


def zeros(d):
    return [[ZERO] * d for _ in range(d)]


def eye(d):
    return [[ONE if i == j else ZERO for j in range(d)] for i in range(d)]


def mm(A, B):
    d = len(A)
    return [[sum((A[i][k] * B[k][j] for k in range(d) if A[i][k] and B[k][j]), ZERO)
              for j in range(d)] for i in range(d)]


def add(A, B, c=ONE):
    return [[A[i][j] + c * B[i][j] for j in range(len(A))] for i in range(len(A))]


def sc(c, A):
    return [[c * x for x in row] for row in A]


def dag(A):
    return [[A[j][i].conj() for j in range(len(A))] for i in range(len(A))]


def meq(A, B):
    return all(A[i][j] == B[i][j] for i in range(len(A)) for j in range(len(A)))


def anti(A, B):
    return add(mm(A, B), mm(B, A))


def annih(n):
    """a_0..a_{n-1} on n Jordan-Wigner modes, dense over GA.QI (LSB bitmask basis)."""
    return [fock.to_dense(fock.msc(ONE, fock.ann(i, n)), 2 ** n, ZERO) for i in range(n)]


def majoranas(a):
    out = []
    for ai in a:
        ad = dag(ai)
        out.append(add(ai, ad))
        out.append(sc(I, add(ad, ai, QI(-1))))
    return out


def flat(A):
    return [x for row in A for x in row]


def check_car_and_irreducible_spinor_module():
    ok = True
    for n in (1, 2, 3):
        d = 2 ** n
        a = annih(n)
        ok = ok and all(meq(anti(a[i], dag(a[j])), eye(d) if i == j else zeros(d))
                        and meq(anti(a[i], a[j]), zeros(d)) for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
        g = majoranas(a)
        ok = ok and len(g) == 2 * n
        ok = ok and all(meq(anti(g[j], g[k]), sc(QI(2 * int(j == k)), eye(d)))
                        for j in range(2 * n) for k in range(2 * n))
        mons = []
        for k in range(2 * n + 1):
            for S in combinations(range(2 * n), k):
                X = eye(d)
                for s in S:
                    X = mm(X, g[s])
                mons.append(flat(X))
        ok = ok and len(mons) == 4 ** n and GA.field_rank(mons) == 4 ** n
        stack = [row for ai in a for row in ai]
        ok = ok and d - GA.field_rank(stack) == 1
        grade_dims = [sum(1 for b in range(d) if bin(b).count("1") == k) for k in range(n + 1)]
        binom = [len(list(combinations(range(n), k))) for k in range(n + 1)]
        ok = ok and grade_dims == binom and sum(grade_dims) == d
    GA.check("Fock space of n <= 3 modes: CAR, Clifford relations on 2n Majoranas, irreducible (rank 4^n)", ok)
    return ok


def check_parity_grading_is_chirality():
    ok = True
    for n in (1, 2, 3):
        d = 2 ** n
        a = annih(n)
        g = majoranas(a)
        Gam = eye(d)
        for ai in a:
            Gam = mm(Gam, add(eye(d), mm(dag(ai), ai), QI(-2)))
        ok = ok and all(Gam[b][c] == (QI((-1) ** bin(b).count("1")) if b == c else ZERO)
                        for b in range(d) for c in range(d))
        ok = ok and meq(mm(Gam, Gam), eye(d)) and all(meq(anti(Gam, x), zeros(d)) for x in g)
        top = eye(d)
        for x in g:
            top = mm(top, x)
        c = ONE
        for _ in range(n):
            c = c * QI(0, -1)
        ok = ok and meq(sc(c, top), Gam)
    GA.check("parity (-1)^|S| = (-i)^n g_0 ... g_{2n-1}: the chirality element, anticommuting with each g_j", ok)
    return ok


def rat_inverse(M):
    k = len(M)
    cols = [GA.field_solve([[F(x) for x in r] for r in M], [F(int(i == c)) for i in range(k)]) for c in range(k)]
    return [[cols[c][r] for c in range(k)] for r in range(k)]


def cayley(K):
    k = len(K)
    Id = [[F(int(i == j)) for j in range(k)] for i in range(k)]
    minus = [[Id[i][j] - F(K[i][j]) for j in range(k)] for i in range(k)]
    plus = [[Id[i][j] + F(K[i][j]) for j in range(k)] for i in range(k)]
    return GA.mat_mul(minus, rat_inverse(plus))


def combo(coeffs, g):
    out = zeros(len(g[0]))
    for c, x in zip(coeffs, g):
        if c:
            out = add(out, x, QI(c))
    return out


def clifford_ok(gs, d):
    m = len(gs)
    return all(meq(anti(gs[j], gs[k]), sc(QI(2 * int(j == k)), eye(d))) for j in range(m) for k in range(m))


def check_orthogonal_group_preserves_car_and_pin_implements_it():
    ok = True
    n, d = 2, 4
    g = majoranas(annih(n))
    for K in ANTISYM:
        R = cayley(K)
        ok = ok and GA.mat_mul(R, [list(r) for r in zip(*R)]) == [[F(int(i == j)) for j in range(4)] for i in range(4)]
        ok = ok and clifford_ok([combo(R[j], g) for j in range(4)], d)
    bad = [[F(2), F(0), F(0), F(0)], [F(0), F(1), F(0), F(0)], [F(0), F(0), F(1), F(0)], [F(0), F(1), F(0), F(1)]]
    ok = ok and not clifford_ok([combo(bad[j], g) for j in range(4)], d)

    def refl(u):
        return [[F(int(i == j)) - 2 * u[i] * u[j] for j in range(4)] for i in range(4)]

    gu, gw = combo(UNIT_U, g), combo(UNIT_W, g)
    ok = ok and meq(mm(gu, gu), eye(d)) and meq(mm(gw, gw), eye(d))
    Ru = refl(UNIT_U)
    for j in range(4):
        image = sc(QI(-1), mm(mm(gu, g[j]), gu))          # gu^-1 = gu
        ok = ok and meq(image, combo([Ru[k][j] for k in range(4)], g))
    S = mm(gu, gw)
    Sinv = mm(gw, gu)
    ok = ok and meq(mm(S, Sinv), eye(d))
    Rot = GA.mat_mul(Ru, refl(UNIT_W))
    for j in range(4):
        ok = ok and meq(mm(mm(S, g[j]), Sinv), combo([Rot[k][j] for k in range(4)], g))
    Gam = mm(mm(g[0], g[1]), mm(g[2], g[3]))
    ok = ok and meq(mm(gu, Gam), sc(QI(-1), mm(Gam, gu))) and meq(mm(S, Gam), mm(Gam, S))
    GA.check("O(2n) preserves the CAR; Pin implements reflections, Spin the rotations (n = 2)", ok)
    return ok


def det(M):
    k = len(M)
    if k == 1:
        return M[0][0]
    out = ZERO
    for j in range(k):
        minor = [row[:j] + row[j + 1:] for row in M[1:]]
        term = M[0][j] * det(minor)
        out = out + term if j % 2 == 0 else out - term
    return out


def lam(gm, a):
    """Lambda(g) on Fock space, column |S> = (g a^dag_{s1}) ... (g a^dag_{sk}) |0>."""
    n = len(gm)
    d = 2 ** n
    ad = [dag(x) for x in a]
    A = [zeros(d) for _ in range(n)]
    for s in range(n):
        for t in range(n):
            A[s] = add(A[s], ad[t], gm[t][s])
    L = zeros(d)
    for b in range(d):
        S = [i for i in range(n) if b >> i & 1]
        v = [ONE if r == 0 else ZERO for r in range(d)]
        for s in reversed(S):
            v = [sum((A[s][r][c] * v[c] for c in range(d) if v[c]), ZERO) for r in range(d)]
        for r in range(d):
            L[r][b] = v[r]
    return L


def check_unitary_group_is_number_preserving_part():
    ok = True
    gms = [G2, mm(mm(R3A, P3), B3)]
    for gm in gms:
        n = len(gm)
        d = 2 ** n
        ok = ok and meq(mm(dag(gm), gm), eye(n))
        a = annih(n)
        ad = [dag(x) for x in a]
        L = lam(gm, a)
        ok = ok and meq(mm(dag(L), L), eye(d))
        Nop = zeros(d)
        for i in range(n):
            Nop = add(Nop, mm(ad[i], a[i]))
        ok = ok and meq(mm(L, Nop), mm(Nop, L))
        for i in range(n):
            rhs = zeros(d)
            for j in range(n):
                rhs = add(rhs, ad[j], gm[j][i])
            ok = ok and meq(mm(L, ad[i]), mm(rhs, L))
        ok = ok and L[d - 1][d - 1] == det(gm) and L[0][0] == ONE
        g = majoranas(a)
        tr0 = QI(d)
        R = []
        for j in range(2 * n):
            gj_new = mm(mm(L, g[j]), dag(L))
            row = []
            for k in range(2 * n):
                t = sum((mm(gj_new, g[k])[r][r] for r in range(d)), ZERO) / tr0
                ok = ok and t.im == 0
                row.append(t.re)
            R.append(row)
        ok = ok and GA.mat_mul(R, [list(r) for r in zip(*R)]) == [[F(int(i == j)) for j in range(2 * n)] for i in range(2 * n)]
        Jc = [[F(0)] * (2 * n) for _ in range(2 * n)]
        for i in range(n):
            Jc[2 * i + 1][2 * i] = F(1)
            Jc[2 * i][2 * i + 1] = F(-1)
        ok = ok and GA.mat_mul(R, Jc) == GA.mat_mul(Jc, R)
    GA.check("U(n) acts as Lambda(g): unitary, number-preserving, implementing g, det g on the top state", ok)
    return ok
rungs.imported-ladder-automorphism-group:
"""rungs.imported-ladder-automorphism-group-no-lepton: exact checks.

(1) Mixings of n conformal spinors (n = 2, 3): Z_i in C^4 = (omega_i, pi_i), the momentum
    P = sum_i pi_i pi_i^dagger (a Hermitian 2 x 2 matrix) and the helicity form sum_i h(Z_i, Z_i) with
    h(Z, Z') = Z^dagger H Z', H = [[0, 1], [1, 0]] in 2 x 2 blocks (signature (2,2)), over Q(i) (GA.QI).
    U (x) 1 preserves both at every sample configuration for sample unitary U (permutations, rational
    rotations, complex unitaries), and for sample non-unitary U (diagonal stretch, shear, a complex
    orthogonal matrix with U^T U = 1) some sample configuration is not preserved: the mixing group is cut
    out by U^dagger U = 1, which is why the two sums (sesquilinear in Z) single out U(n).
(2) The Lie algebra of the automorphisms of C^m (x) C^n is the image of (X, Y) -> X (x) 1 + 1 (x) Y,

def ssyt(shape, n):
    """Content vectors of the semistandard tableaux of the given shape with entries 0..n-1."""
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(shape) for c in range(row)]
    out = Counter()

    def fill(i, T):
        if i == len(cells):
            cont = [0] * n
            for v in T.values():
                cont[v] += 1
            out[tuple(cont)] += 1
            return
        r, c = cells[i]
        lo = 0
        if c > 0:
            lo = max(lo, T[(r, c - 1)])
        if r > 0:
            lo = max(lo, T[(r - 1, c)] + 1)
        for v in range(lo, n):
            T[(r, c)] = v
            fill(i + 1, T)
            del T[(r, c)]

    fill(0, {})
    return out


def schur(hw, n):
    """Character of the U(n) irreducible with highest weight hw (entries may be negative)."""
    m = min(hw)
    shape = [h - m for h in hw]
    ch = ssyt([s for s in shape if s > 0], n)
    return Counter({tuple(x + m for x in w): c for w, c in ch.items()})

        m = ch[top]

        out.append((top, m))
        ch.subtract(Counter({k: m * v for k, v in irr_char(*top).items()}))
        ch = Counter({k: v for k, v in ch.items() if v})
    return out

def ssyt(shape, n):
    """Content vectors of the semistandard tableaux of the given shape with entries 0..n-1."""
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(shape) for c in range(row)]
    out = Counter()

    def fill(i, T):
        if i == len(cells):
            cont = [0] * n
            for v in T.values():
                cont[v] += 1
            out[tuple(cont)] += 1
            return
        r, c = cells[i]
        lo = 0
        if c > 0:
            lo = max(lo, T[(r, c - 1)])
        if r > 0:
            lo = max(lo, T[(r - 1, c)] + 1)
        for v in range(lo, n):
            T[(r, c)] = v
            fill(i + 1, T)
            del T[(r, c)]

    fill(0, {})
    return out


def schur(hw, n):
    """Character of the U(n) irreducible with highest weight hw (entries may be negative)."""
    m = min(hw)
    shape = [h - m for h in hw]
    ch = ssyt([s for s in shape if s > 0], n)
    return Counter({tuple(x + m for x in w): c for w, c in ch.items()})


def irr_char(lam, mu):
    a, b = schur(lam, 2), schur(mu, 3)
    return Counter({(wa, wb): ca * cb for wa, ca in a.items() for wb, cb in b.items()})


def decompose(ch):
    """List of ((lam, mu), multiplicity) for a U(2) x U(3) character."""
    ch = Counter({k: v for k, v in ch.items() if v})
    out = []
    while ch:
        top = max(ch)
        m = ch[top]
        if m < 0:
            return None
        out.append((top, m))
        ch.subtract(Counter({k: m * v for k, v in irr_char(*top).items()}))
        ch = Counter({k: v for k, v in ch.items() if v})
    return out

    yL = -3 * yQ                                   # [SU(2)]^2 U(1): 3 Y_Q + Y_L = 0
    s = -2 * yQ                                    # [SU(3)]^2 U(1): 2 Y_Q + Y_u + Y_d = 0

    rest = 6 * yQ ** 3 + 2 * yL ** 3 + ye ** 3     # U(1)^3: rest + 3 (Y_u^3 + Y_d^3) = 0
    cubes = -rest / 3                              # Y_u^3 + Y_d^3 = s^3 - 3 s p
    p = (s ** 3 - cubes) / (3 * s)
    return yL, ye, s, p

rungs.imported-totality-minimality-compl:
"""rungs.imported-totality-minimality-completion: exact checks of the three imported clauses.

(1) No equivariant element-level inverse of null vectors (finite core of the no-go): in Cl(V) and
    in its ascent Cl(V + H), for the mixed signatures (2,1), (1,2), (1,3), (3,1), (2,2): v null,
    w0 null with v.w0 = 1/2, u in {v, w0}^perp with Q(u) != 0. Sample pseudo-inverses
    sigma = w0 + alpha + v beta + v w0 delta (alpha, beta, delta generated by {v, w0}^perp,
    including the ascent's e+, e-) satisfy v sigma v = v. The null rotation R = 1 + v u equals
    u' u / Q(u) with u' = u + Q(u) v (a product of two invertible vectors), fixes v, and
    R sigma R^{-1} - sigma + u is annihilated by left multiplication with v while v u != 0: so
    R sigma R^{-1} != sigma, and no sigma is equivariant.
(2) The conformal model of the completion (exported by the transport.minimality check) adjoins one
    hyperbolic plane: Gram signature (p+1, q+1) with (n0, ninf) a hyperbolic pair, for all signatures
    with n <= 4. Minimality and uniqueness up to isometry are tested in transport.minimality, not here.
(3) iota[N] = [e+ N e+] is total and involutive (e+ (e+ N e+) e+ = N, nonzero null vectors to
    nonzero null vectors), equals the reciprocal on invertible x (iota X(x) = -Q(x) X(x/Q(x))),
    sends null x0 to [x0 + ninf/2], and iota X(x) = -J(x) with J(x) = Q(x) n0 + x + ninf/2 for every
    x; J is polynomial and J(x0 + h d) - J(x0) has zero constant term in h (Lagrange extrapolation to
    h = 0 through three h and through all four, sample directions d), so iota[X(x)] -> [x0 + ninf/2] along every invertible path.
"""
from fractions import Fraction as F

import GA
from tp_premise import premise

MIXED = [(2, 1), (1, 2), (1, 3), (3, 1), (2, 2)]


def _nogo_case(p, q, ascent):
    """v, w0, u and sample alpha/beta/delta in Cl(V) (ascent False) or Cl(V + H)."""
    n = p + q
    sq = GA.sig(p, q) + ((1, -1) if ascent else ())
    v = GA.add(GA.gen(0), GA.gen(p))                        # e_0 + e_p, null
    w0 = GA.scal(F(1, 4), GA.sub(GA.gen(0), GA.gen(p)))     # null, v.w0 = 1/2
    perp = [GA.gen(i) for i in range(1, n) if i != p] + ([GA.gen(n), GA.gen(n + 1)] if ascent else [])
    return sq, v, w0, perp


def _samples(perp, sq):
    a = perp[0]
    b = perp[-1]
    ab = GA.mul(a, b, sq) if len(perp) > 1 else GA.sc(3)
    alpha = GA.add(GA.sc(2), GA.scal(F(-1, 2), a), ab)
    beta = GA.add(GA.scal(5, b), GA.sc(1))
    delta = GA.add(GA.sc(F(1, 3)), GA.scal(7, ab))
    return [({}, {}, {}), (alpha, {}, {}), (alpha, beta, delta), ({}, beta, delta)]


def check_no_equivariant_pseudo_inverse_of_null_vectors():
    premise("transport.no-go-level-elements")
    ok = True
    cases = 0
    for (p, q) in MIXED:
        for ascent in (False, True):
            sq, v, w0, perp = _nogo_case(p, q, ascent)
            ok = ok and GA.is_zero(GA.mul(v, v, sq)) and GA.is_zero(GA.mul(w0, w0, sq))
            ok = ok and GA.dot(v, w0, sq) == F(1, 2)
            u = perp[0]
            Qu = GA.mul(u, u, sq).get((), F(0))
            ok = ok and Qu != 0 and GA.dot(u, v, sq) == 0 and GA.dot(u, w0, sq) == 0
            R = GA.add(GA.sc(1), GA.mul(v, u, sq))
            Rinv = GA.sub(GA.sc(1), GA.mul(v, u, sq))
            ok = ok and GA.eq(GA.mul(R, Rinv, sq), GA.sc(1))
            up = GA.add(u, GA.scal(Qu, v))
            ok = ok and GA.eq(GA.scal(1 / Qu, GA.mul(up, u, sq)), R)
            ok = ok and GA.eq(GA.mul(GA.mul(R, v, sq), Rinv, sq), v)
            vu = GA.mul(v, u, sq)
            ok = ok and not GA.is_zero(vu)
            for alpha, beta, delta in _samples(perp, sq):
                sigma = GA.add(w0, alpha, GA.mul(v, beta, sq), GA.mul(GA.mul(v, w0, sq), delta, sq))
                ok = ok and GA.eq(GA.mul(GA.mul(v, sigma, sq), v, sq), v)
                moved = GA.mul(GA.mul(R, sigma, sq), Rinv, sq)
                rest = GA.add(GA.sub(moved, sigma), u)
                ok = ok and GA.is_zero(GA.mul(v, rest, sq))
                ok = ok and not GA.eq(moved, sigma)
                cases += 1
    ok = ok and cases == 40
    GA.check("null rotations fixing v move every pseudo-inverse of v (Cl(V) and the ascent), 5 signatures", ok)
    return ok


def check_conformal_model_adjoins_one_hyperbolic_plane():
    ex = premise("transport.minimality")
    conformal = ex["conformal"]
    ok = True
    count = 0
    for n in range(0, 5):
        for p in range(n + 1):
            q = n - p
            M = conformal(p, q)
            sq = M["sq"]
            basis = [GA.gen(i) for i in range(n + 2)]
            G = [[GA.dot(a, b, sq) for b in basis] for a in basis]
            ok = ok and GA.congruence_signature(G) == (p + 1, q + 1, 0)
            plane = [[GA.dot(a, b, sq) for b in (M["n0"], M["ninf"])] for a in (M["n0"], M["ninf"])]
            ok = ok and plane == [[0, -1], [-1, 0]]
            count += 1
    ok = ok and count == 15
    GA.check("the conformal model adjoins one hyperbolic plane, increment (+1,+1), all 15 signatures n <= 4", ok)
    return ok


def _lagrange0(hs, vals):
    out = {}
    for i, hi in enumerate(hs):
        w = F(1)
        for j, hj in enumerate(hs):
            if j != i:
                w *= (0 - hj) / (hi - hj)
        out = GA.add(out, GA.scal(w, vals[i]))
    return out


def check_transported_reciprocal_total_involutive_continuous():
    ex = premise("transport.minimality")
    premise("transport.totality")
    conformal = ex["conformal"]
    ok = True
    nulls = 0
    for (p, q) in MIXED:
        M = conformal(p, q)
        n, sq, n0, ninf = M["n"], M["sq"], M["n0"], M["ninf"]

        x0s = [{}, M["vec"]([1 if i in (0, p) else 0 for i in range(n)]),

        for x in xs + x0s:

            Xx = M["X"](x)
            I = M["iota"](Xx)
            ok = ok and GA.eq(M["iota"](I), Xx)                                  # involution
            ok = ok and GA.is_zero(GA.mul(I, I, sq)) and not GA.is_zero(I)        # total on the quadric
            J = GA.add(GA.scal(Qx, n0), x, GA.scal(F(1, 2), ninf))
            ok = ok and GA.eq(I, GA.scal(-1, J))
            if Qx != 0:
                ok = ok and GA.eq(I, GA.scal(-Qx, M["X"](GA.scal(1 / Qx, x))))    # reciprocal
            else:
                nulls += 1
                ok = ok and GA.eq(I, GA.scal(-1, GA.add(x, GA.scal(F(1, 2), ninf))))
                for d in xs:
                    hs = [F(1, 10), F(1, 100), F(-1, 7), F(1, 1000)]

                        Qh = M["Q"](xh)
                        vals.append(GA.add(GA.scal(Qh, n0), xh, GA.scal(F(1, 2), ninf)))
                    ok = ok and GA.eq(_lagrange0(hs[:3], vals[:3]), J) and GA.eq(_lagrange0(hs, vals), J)
        # the ideal points: iota swaps n0 and ninf up to scale
        ok = ok and GA.eq(M["iota"](n0), GA.scal(F(-1, 2), ninf)) and GA.eq(M["iota"](ninf), GA.scal(-2, n0))
    ok = ok and nulls == 15
    GA.check("iota total, involutive, the reciprocal on invertible x, [x0 + ninf/2] at null x0 as a limit", ok)
